nodes.title: OPTIONAL REFERENCE + FIXED 4:5 CROP · None = prompt-only
REQUEST / PROMPT · full scene with None, changes with reference
WORKFLOW GUIDE
widgets_values:
FINAL KURVA MAKER · KREA 2 TURBO

CONTROL PANEL
Choose an optional reference, write the request, inspect the final slider, and use Advanced Settings for seed, sampling, batch size, and three editable LoRA slots. Trigger text is added only while its LoRA strength is non-zero.

PROMPT-ONLY MODE
Choose [None — prompt-only mode] and describe the complete desired photograph. Krea2 generates a new generic fictional adult subject; the FLUX-trained Alex Sparks LoRA is deliberately not loaded because it is incompatible with Krea2.

REFERENCE MODE
Upload an image and move/zoom the permanently locked 4:5 crop. Describe only the desired changes. The selected pixels enter Qwen analysis, Krea2's VAE reference-token path, Krea2's grounded Qwen3-VL encoder, and the comparison viewer. General Edit V2 is active at the measured strength.

OUTPUT
The diffusion render is a true native 1280 × 1600 image. FameGrid Color Finish runs after decode. A separate 1080 × 1350 Instagram delivery copy is saved with Lanczos. This workflow does not claim a resized image is native 4K; Krea2 Edit's documented reliable range is at or below about two megapixels.

KNOWN LIMIT
Reference mode supplies identity and composition through Krea2 General Edit. A reusable Alex identity in prompt-only mode needs a Krea2-trained character LoRA; the existing alexsparks.safetensors is FLUX.2 Klein-specific.

nodes.title: 1 · Analyze reference image · Qwen3-VL
widgets_values: Analyze the supplied reference photograph for a Krea 2 General Edit instruction. Output only a precise English source description, with no heading or commentary. Describe the exact camera position, 4:5 crop, rectilinear perspective, composition, subject count and placement, pose, proportions, hands, expression, hair, garments, lighting, focal plane, depth of field, background blur, white balance, exposure, contrast, saturation, major colors, objects, architecture, and spatial relationships. Treat visible pixels as authoritative defaults. Do not improve, mute, sharpen, recolor, or redesign them. The final canvas is a full-bleed vertical 4:5 photograph with straight boundaries and no fisheye, black corners, rounded mask, letterbox, or border. A later authoritative request may replace any named attribute; do not prohibit changes. End with safeguards against duplicate people, extra or missing limbs/digits, malformed anatomy, warped geometry, text, watermarks, and unrelated additions.

nodes.title: Reference mode · Krea2 preservation rules
widgets_values: REFERENCE MODE: use the selected photograph as the Krea2 source image. Its selected 4:5 pixels define the default composition, identity, pose, scene, depth of field, colorimetry, lighting, and geometry. Preserve every visible attribute the authoritative request does not replace. Apply the requested changes clearly while keeping exactly one main foreground adult woman unless the request explicitly asks for more people. Never duplicate, clone, mirror, or add a second version of her. The photographer, camera, and phone stay outside the frame unless explicitly requested. Produce a full-bleed vertical 4:5 rectilinear photograph without fisheye, curved boundaries, black corners, rounded masks, letterboxing, pillarboxing, borders, text, or watermarks.

nodes.title: PROMPT-ONLY MODE · internal base instruction
widgets_values: PROMPT-ONLY MODE: generate a new image from scratch with Krea 2 Turbo. There is no reference photograph or source identity. Treat the authoritative request as the complete scene specification and expand only concrete details it provides. Render exactly one fictional adult woman unless another subject count is explicitly requested. The photographer, phone, and camera remain outside the frame. Make a candid, plausible Instagram photograph with natural anatomy, coherent geometry, believable lighting, ordinary photographic imperfections, and a full-bleed vertical 4:5 rectilinear frame. Avoid duplicate subjects, extra or missing limbs or digits, malformed hands, warped straight lines, fisheye, black corners, borders, text, and watermarks.

widgets_values: Rewrite the user's message as one precise visual instruction for a Krea 2 Turbo workflow. Output only the instruction. The message is either a complete prompt-only scene or a requested change to a reference image. Retain every concrete detail. Treat the main subject as an adult. State exact subject count, pose, anatomy, clothing, setting, camera position, framing, lighting, focus, and colors whenever the user supplied them. For removals, explicitly state that the item is completely absent and describe the naturally reconstructed area. For camera changes, specify position, height, direction, distance, lens perspective, and framing. Preserve all unnamed source attributes in reference mode. Keep exactly one main foreground woman unless the user explicitly requests more; never duplicate, clone, mirror, or place the photographer or phone in frame. Do not mention policies, editing steps, or these rules.

nodes.title: Combine selected source mode and request
3 · Compile one conflict-free Krea2 prompt
widgets_values: Compile one final production-ready Krea 2 Turbo prompt. Output only the final prompt, without headings or commentary. The input begins with REFERENCE MODE or PROMPT-ONLY MODE followed by an authoritative request. Put requested changes first and resolve conflicts into one desired visible state. Never retain superseded source wording. In reference mode, preserve concretely described source identity, composition, pose, geometry, lighting, focus falloff, colors, and objects unless the request changes them. In prompt-only mode, produce a self-contained scene description. Always describe exactly one main foreground adult woman unless the request explicitly requires more; never create a duplicate, clone, reflection, second copy, visible photographer, camera, or phone. Use a full-bleed vertical 4:5 rectilinear photographic frame with natural proportions, plausible hands, coherent perspective, authentic Instagram color and texture, and no fisheye, black corners, rounded mask, borders, text, or watermark. Keep the result concise: 120 to 240 words.
